question: An engineer must configure device aliases for a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switches-based SAN fabric. The configuration must meet these requirements: the engineer must be prompted before the changes are committed to the database; and pending changes must be explicitly displayed on the console. Which command accomplishes this task?
theory: Because 'device-alias commit' normally distributes pending changes to the whole fabric immediately, NX-OS also offers 'device-alias confirm-commit', which adds an interactive confirmation step - it explicitly displays the pending changes on the console and requires the administrator to confirm before those changes are actually committed and distributed via CFS, giving a chance to review the diffs first rather than committing blind. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - Device Alias / web research)
